1920.s: As she changed into her brown georgette she ran over the puzzling situation, and racked her brain for a way to meet it.

She made Nancy in her best brown georgette feel uncomfortably dowdyish, or would have made her feel dowdyish if young Andy had not been whispering into her pink ear that he was not surprised a bit that his grandfather adored her and asking her if she knew that…
